LANスキャンとRaspberry Piを用いて研究室の在室状況を可視化し、Di: An attendance system that uses LAN scanning and a Raspberry Pi to visualize who's in the lab, linked with Discord roles
LANスキャンとRaspberry Piを用いて研究室メンバーの在室状況を物理L:
Using LAN scanning and a Raspberry Pi, we built a system that shows who's in the lab on physical LEDs
and automatically syncs it with Discord roles, developed as a team.
Node.jsでLAN内の端末を定期スキャンし、MACアドレスと登録ユーザー情報:
A system that periodically scans devices on the LAN with Node.js and matches MAC addresses against registered users to determine who's in the lab.
Instead of single scans, it uses sliding-window history and threshold checks to prevent false readings caused by network fluctuations.
Attendance is shown on physical LEDs via Raspberry Pi GPIO, and also synced to roles on the lab's Discord server through a Discord bot.
Node.js calls Python scripts, separating attendance logic from GPIO control for better maintainability and extensibility.

アイドルを支える裏方として、ファンレターやプレゼントを検閲し、安全を守るゲーム企:
A game pitch about working behind the scenes for an idol, screening fan letters and gifts to keep the idol safe.
Players sort mail accurately within a time limit, following screening rules that change every day. The heart of the game is the psychological conflict between the duty to follow the rules and the wish to deliver fans' feelings. Wrong calls can hurt the idol or break trust, so accuracy and judgment are essential.
More than a simple task game, it's an adventure game that lets you feel the responsibility and pressure of supporting an idol from behind the scenes.

学部研究「テキストによる視覚提示数がゲーム体験に及ぼす影響」の実験用に制作しまし:
Made for the experiments in my undergraduate research, "How the Amount of On-Screen Text Affects the Game Experience."
Participants played three stages, each with a different amount of on-screen text, and answered a questionnaire after each stage. Using those subjective ratings along with objective metrics from game logs (retry counts and clear times), I statistically analyzed how the amount of text affects the game experience.
I later presented this research at an academic conference.

通常のモニターと球状のモニターを用いた2画面マルチプレイのコミュニケーションゲー:
A two-screen multiplayer communication game using a regular monitor and a spherical monitor.
As Dream Supporters, two players protect a resident's (NPC's) sleep—one from inside the dream, one from reality. The dream-side player watches the sleeping resident's dream, spots anomalies, and reports them to the other player. The reality-side player uses that information to find the cause and deal with it. Together, they aim to keep the resident sleeping soundly until morning.
